reuse.why: Uses getSheetValue, setBudget, batchMessages and isTrackingBudget, but copies the category selection instead of extracting a shared selector for the month-wide actions it must stay consistent with.

duplication.why: The category query (hidden, hidden group, goal_def), the income-outside-tracking skip and the expense sign flip are copied from set3/6/12MonthAvg, making a fifth copy of the selection rule.

placement.why: The action sits beside the other month-wide actions in budget/actions.ts and is registered with mutator(undoable(...)) in budget/app.ts like them.

scope.why: Only the new action, its registration and a test.

maintainability.why: "Same categories as the other month-wide actions" is kept true only by copy; the next exclusion rule must be added to yet another query, and the copies already differ (setZero uses COALESCE on group hidden).

bypasses_abstraction.where: the tree has no shared month-wide category selector to bypass; the selection is copied rather than routed around an abstraction

disguised_duplication.where: the copied SQL and income check are verbatim; the sign flip is only lightly reshaped (`-spending` vs `avg *= -1`)
